nodes.text: Manual AITL target built from the human-provided CyberChair prose.
This workspace is a trace artifact for debugging AutoCedar, not an automatically generated session.
1. Authors can submit abstracts/papers during step 1.
2. Authors with step-2 credentials can upload full papers during step 2.
3. Authors can correct step-1 submission information during step 2.
4. Authors of selected submissions can submit camera-ready papers after review.
5. Assigned reviewers can access/download assigned papers after paper distribution, unless they have declared a conflict of interest.
6. Assigned non-conflicted reviewers can submit or update reviews while review is open.
7. Reviewers can read other reviewers' reviews for a paper only after submitting their own review for that paper.
8. Reviewers can declare conflicts of interest for assigned papers.
9. Reviewers may volunteer for papers with conflicting reviews only after they have submitted all assigned reviews and are not conflicted with the paper.
10. Chairs/PCC can monitor the review process and identify low-expertise papers.
11. PCC can ask an additional reviewer to review a low-expertise paper.
12. Reviewer directories and review files are protected from outsiders by per-directory allowed-user lists.

atom.name: p0003_submitStep1_author_during_step1
atom.rationale: The requirement specifies that authors have the ability to submit during step 1. This requires two conditions: (1) the principal must be listed in the submission's authors set, and (2) the submission must have step1Open set to true. Both conditions must be satisfied for the action to be allowed.
atom.plain_english_summary: The principal must be an author of the submission, and step 1 must be open for submissions.
atom.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0003.l9] Authors can submit abstracts/papers during step 1.
atom.reference_cedar: permit (principal is User, action == Action::"submitStep1", resource is Submission) when { resource.authors.contains(principal) && resource.step1Open };

required_schema_support.reason: Principal must be of type User to perform submitStep1

atom.name: submitFullPaper_step2_author
atom.rationale: The requirement explicitly states that authors (1) with step-2 credentials (2) can upload during step 2 (3). All three conditions must hold: the principal must be in the submission's authors set, the context must indicate step-2 credentials, and the submission's step-2 phase must be open.
atom.plain_english_summary: The principal must be listed as an author of the submission, must have step-2 credentials, and step 2 must currently be open.
atom.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0004.l10] 2. Authors with step-2 credentials can upload full papers during step 2.
atom.reference_cedar: permit (principal is User, action == Action::"submitFullPaper", resource is Submission) when { resource.authors.contains(principal) && context.hasStep2Credential && resource.step2Open };

required_schema_support.reason: Required to check if principal is an author of the submission

atom.name: author_during_step2
atom.rationale: The requirement states authors can correct step-1 information during step 2. This encodes the two conditions: the principal must appear in the submission's authors set, and the submission's step2Open flag must be true.
atom.plain_english_summary: The principal must be an author of the submission, and step 2 must be open for corrections.
atom.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0005.l11] Authors can correct step-1 submission information during step 2.
atom.reference_cedar: permit (principal is User, action == Action::"updateStep1Info", resource is Submission) when { resource.authors.contains(principal) && resource.step2Open };

atom.name: submitCameraReady_author_of_selected_after_review
atom.rationale: The requirement explicitly requires three conditions: the user must be listed as an author (author role check via resource.authors), the submission must be selected for the conference (selected flag), and the review phase must be finished (reviewProcessDone flag indicates review is complete). The Cedar syntax now matches the approved pattern used in this scope.
atom.plain_english_summary: The principal must be an author of the submission, the submission must be marked as selected, and the review process must be complete.
atom.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0006.l12] Authors of selected submissions can submit camera-ready papers after review.
symbolic_verification_log: match-vacuity: ok (policy match condition is reachable)

atom.name: assigned_reviewer_post_distribution_not_conflicted
atom.rationale: The requirement permits assigned reviewers to download papers after distribution, but excludes those with declared conflicts. This condition enforces all three requirements: reviewer assignment status, distribution timing, and conflict status.
atom.plain_english_summary: The principal must be an assigned reviewer of the submission, paper distribution must be complete, and the principal must not have declared a conflict of interest.
atom.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0007.l13] "Assigned reviewers can access/download assigned papers after paper distribution, unless they have declared a conflict of interest."
atom.reference_cedar: permit (principal is User, action == Action::"downloadPaper", resource is Submission) when { resource.assignedReviewers.contains(principal) && resource.distributionDone && !(resource.conflictedReviewers.contains(principal)) };
symbolic_verification_log: match-vacuity: ok (policy match condition is reachable)

atom.name: submitReview_assigned_non_conflicted_reviewer
atom.rationale: The requirement states assigned non-conflicted reviewers can submit reviews while review is open. This condition enforces all three constraints: principal must be assigned, must not be conflicted, and review must be open.
atom.plain_english_summary: The principal must be an assigned reviewer on the submission, not be in the conflicted reviewers set, and the review period must be open.
atom.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0008.l15] Assigned non-conflicted reviewers can submit or update reviews while review is open.
atom.reference_cedar: permit (principal is User, action == Action::"submitReview", resource is Submission) when { resource.assignedReviewers.contains(principal) && !resource.conflictedReviewers.contains(principal) && resource.reviewOpen };

atom.name: reviewer_submitted_own_review
atom.rationale: The requirement explicitly conditions the action on the reviewer having submitted their own review first. This is checked by verifying that the principal appears in the submission's reviewersSubmitted set.
atom.plain_english_summary: The principal must have already submitted their own review for the submission.
atom.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0009.l16] Reviewers can read other reviewers' reviews for a paper only after submitting their own review for that paper.
atom.reference_cedar: permit (principal is User, action == Action::"readOtherReviews", resource is Submission) when { resource.reviewersSubmitted.contains(principal) };

atom.name: assigned_reviewer_can_declare_conflict
atom.rationale: The requirement specifies that reviewers can declare conflicts for assigned papers. This means the principal must be in the submission's assignedReviewers set to have permission to declare a conflict.
atom.plain_english_summary: The principal is an assigned reviewer for the submission.
atom.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0010.l18] Reviewers can declare conflicts of interest for assigned papers.
symbolic_verification_log: match-vacuity: ok (policy match condition is reachable)

atom.name: reviewer_submitted_all_reviews_not_conflicted
atom.rationale: The requirement explicitly conditions volunteering for conflicting papers on two prerequisites: (1) the reviewer must have completed all assigned reviews, checked via the User.submittedAllAssignedReviews attribute, and (2) the reviewer must not be in the paper's conflictedReviewers set. The role check ensures only reviewers (not authors or other users) can volunteer.
atom.plain_english_summary: The principal must be a Reviewer who has submitted all assigned reviews and is not conflicted with the paper.
atom.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0011.l19] Reviewers may volunteer for papers with conflicting reviews only after they have submitted all assigned reviews and are not conflicted with the paper.
atom.reference_cedar: permit (principal is User, action == Action::"volunteerForConflictingPaper", resource is Submission) when { principal.role == "Reviewer" && principal.submittedAllAssignedReviews && !(resource.conflictedReviewers.contains(principal)) };
symbolic_verification_log: match-vacuity: ok (policy match condition is reachable)

atom.name: chair_pcc_role_check
atom.rationale: The requirement explicitly grants monitoring access only to users with the role 'Chair' or 'PCC'. The condition checks the principal's role attribute against these two permitted values using OR logic, as either role qualifies.
atom.plain_english_summary: The principal's role must be 'Chair' or 'PCC' to monitor the review process.
atom.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0012.l21] 10. Chairs/PCC can monitor the review process and identify low-expertise papers.

atom.name: PCC_asks_additional_reviewer_for_low_expertise_paper
atom.rationale: The requirement explicitly states 'PCC can ask an additional reviewer to review a low-expertise paper.' This requires two conditions: (1) the principal must be a PCC, checked via the role attribute, and (2) the paper must be low-expertise, indicated by having only non-expert reviews (onlyNonExpertReviews flag). Both must be true to grant permission.
atom.plain_english_summary: A Program Committee Chair (PCC) can request an additional reviewer for a paper that has only non-expert reviews.

atom.name: reviewer_directory_allowed_users_access
atom.rationale: The requirement states reviewer directories are protected by per-directory allowed-user lists. This atom checks that the principal is in the ReviewerDirectory's allowedUsers set.
atom.plain_english_summary: A user can access a reviewer directory if and only if they are on the directory's allowed-users list.

atom.name: review_file_directory_protection
atom.rationale: The requirement states review files are protected by per-directory allowed-user lists. Since review files exist within directories, access is controlled by the directory's allowedUsers list that the file references.
atom.plain_english_summary: A user can read a review file if and only if they are on the allowed-users list of the file's directory.
atom.source_excerpt: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0014.l23] Reviewer directories and review files are protected from outsiders by per-directory allowed-user lists.
atom.reference_cedar: permit (principal is User, action == Action::"readReviewFile", resource is ReviewFile) when { resource.directory.allowedUsers.contains(principal) };
